newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GE Life makes S$340 mln land tender bid.
newsitem.headline: GE Life makes S$340 mln land tender bid.

text.p: Great Eastern Life Assurance Co Ltd put in the highest bid of Singapore $340.05 million for a prime development site, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) said on Wednesday.

Great Eastern, partnered by Merevale Holdings Pte Ltd, beat off competition from three other tenderers for the site in Singapore's China Square development, in the heart of the city state's business district.
URA said in a statement the proposed use of the site could be for any combination of commercial, residential, hotel, or medical development (excluding hospital or sanitorium development).
